milestones.description: Lands the shared @repo/ai-eval package, four paired Supabase migrations (chatflow_targets with pgsodium encryption, question_sets/items, chatflow_runs/rows, storage buckets), pgsodium key provisioning, and the core engine (chatflow-client, rolling-concurrency queue, csv parser, langfuse links, target-store with encrypt/decrypt, run-store, tier-limits, zod schemas) plus shared UI components (TargetEditor, TargetPicker, StatusBar, ProgressOverlay, ResultsTable). issues.title: Migration: chatflow_targets with pgsodium-encrypted api_token
issues.body:
## Summary
Land `supabase/migrations/20260505_chatflow_01_targets.sql` (+ `.down.sql`) creating `public.chatflow_targets` with per-user RLS and a pgsodium-encrypted `api_token_encrypted` column. This is the first table in the repo to use `pgsodium` for at-rest secret storage; nothing else here decrypts at the SQL layer — decryption happens server-side in `@repo/ai-eval/target-store` only.

Schema (per plan):
- `id uuid pk default gen_random_uuid()`
- `user_id uuid not null references auth.users(id) on delete cascade`
- `name text not null check (length(trim(name)) > 0)`
- `api_host text not null`
- `chatflow_id text not null`
- `api_token_encrypted text not null`
- `api_token_key_id uuid not null`
- `base_trace_url text` (optional Langfuse base)
- `default_tag text`
- `prompt_template text` (csv-chatflow only; null for eval-only)
- `streaming boolean not null default false`
- `"createdAt" / "updatedAt" timestamptz`
- `updated_at` trigger following meme-generator precedent
- `idx_chatflow_targets_user(user_id)`

RLS: own-only SELECT/INSERT/UPDATE/DELETE keyed on `auth.uid() = user_id`.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] `create extension if not exists pgsodium;` is in the migration (idempotent)
- [ ] Up + down migrations land as a pair; `pnpm lint` (`scripts/check-migration-pairs.ts`) passes
- [ ] All four RLS policies present and named per the plan
- [ ] `updatedAt` trigger function follows the `set_chatflow_*_updated_at()` pattern from meme-generator
- [ ] `pnpm db:reset` succeeds locally and the table exists with RLS enabled
- [ ] Cross-user SELECT rejected when querying via the anon-role client (verified in a test or manual repro documented on the PR)

issues.title: Migration: question_sets and question_set_items
issues.body:
## Summary
Land `supabase/migrations/20260505_chatflow_02_question_sets.sql` (+ `.down.sql`) creating `public.question_sets` and `public.question_set_items` for the chatflow-eval app. Per-user RLS on `question_sets`; on `question_set_items` RLS goes through an `EXISTS` subquery against the parent set.

Schema (per plan):
- `question_sets`: `id`, `user_id` (cascade), `target_id` references `chatflow_targets(id) on delete cascade`, `name text not null`, `tag text`, `"createdAt" / "updatedAt"`
- `question_set_items`: `id`, `set_id` references `question_sets(id) on delete cascade`, `uid text not null`, `question text not null`, `position integer not null default 0`, `unique (set_id, uid)`

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Up + down migrations paired; `pnpm lint` passes
- [ ] All eight RLS policies (4 per table) present and named per the plan
- [ ] `unique (set_id, uid)` enforced — duplicate uid in same set rejected
- [ ] Cascade behavior: deleting a `chatflow_target` removes its sets and items; deleting a set removes its items
- [ ] `updatedAt` trigger on `question_sets`

issues.title: Migration: chatflow_runs and chatflow_run_rows
issues.body:
## Summary
Land `supabase/migrations/20260505_chatflow_03_runs.sql` (+ `.down.sql`) creating the run-history tables shared by both apps. `mode` enum distinguishes eval vs csv runs; `status` enum tracks queued/running/completed/cancelled/errored.

Schema (per plan):
- enums: `chatflow_run_mode ('eval','csv')`, `chatflow_run_status ('queued','running','completed','cancelled','errored')`
- `chatflow_runs`: `id`, `user_id` (cascade), `target_id` references `chatflow_targets(id) on delete restrict`, `mode`, `status default 'queued'`, `question_set_id` (eval mode), `upload_storage_path` (csv mode), `prompt_template` snapshot, `tag`, `concurrency`, `total_rows`, `completed_rows`, `errored_rows`, `results_storage_path`, `"startedAt" / "finishedAt"`, `error`
- `chatflow_run_rows`: `id`, `run_id` (cascade), `position`, `uid`, `input jsonb`, `status`, `response_text`, `response_json`, `langfuse_link`, `error`, `"startedAt" / "finishedAt"`, `unique (run_id, uid)`
- Indexes: `idx_chatflow_runs_user_started(user_id, "startedAt" desc)`, `idx_chatflow_run_rows_run(run_id, position)`

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Up + down migrations paired; `pnpm lint` passes
- [ ] Both enums created (idempotent if re-run)
- [ ] All RLS policies present per the plan (own runs; row policies via `EXISTS` against parent run)
- [ ] `target_id ... on delete restrict` (so deleting a target with active history fails loudly — never silently orphan run rows)
- [ ] Indexes created for the two hot read paths (run history list, row-by-position fetch)

issues.title: Migration: chatflow-uploads and chatflow-results storage buckets + RLS
issues.body:
## Summary
Land `supabase/migrations/20260505_chatflow_04_storage.sql` (+ `.down.sql`) creating two private Supabase Storage buckets and their per-user RLS policies, following the meme-generator precedent.

Buckets:
- `chatflow-uploads` — user-uploaded CSVs, `public=false`, 25 MB cap, mime `text/csv`/`application/csv`
- `chatflow-results` — generated result CSVs, `public=false`, 50 MB cap, mime `text/csv`

Path layout: `<user_id>/<run_id>/<filename>.csv`.

Policies:
- `chatflow-uploads`: users can SELECT/INSERT/DELETE their own folder (`storage.foldername(name))[1] = auth.uid()::text`)
- `chatflow-results`: users can SELECT/DELETE their own folder. **No INSERT policy** — only the service role (server actions running `exportRunCSV`) writes to this bucket

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Up + down migrations paired; `pnpm lint` passes
- [ ] Bucket inserts are idempotent (`on conflict (id) do nothing`)
- [ ] Cross-user upload-folder reads rejected (verified via a manual repro or test)
- [ ] Anon/auth-role inserts to `chatflow-results` rejected (no policy = denied by default)
- [ ] Down migration drops policies and buckets cleanly

export const QUESTION_SET_QUOTA = { free: 3, pro: 50, enterprise: -1 } as const;

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] `ChatflowTargetInput` schema validates `api_host` as URL, `api_token` as non-empty string (write-only — never on the output schema), `base_trace_url` as optional URL, `prompt_template` length ≤ 16 KiB

issues.title: @repo/ai-eval: langfuse.ts link generation
issues.body:
## Summary
Implement `packages/ai-eval/src/langfuse.ts` exporting `generateLangfuseLink(opts: { baseUrl?: string; tag?: string; uid: string }): string | null`.

When `baseUrl` is set: returns `${baseUrl}/traces?tag=${encodeURIComponent("${tag}_${uid}")}` (when tag set) or `${baseUrl}/traces?tag=${encodeURIComponent(uid)}` (no tag). When `baseUrl` is unset: returns `null`.

issues.title: @repo/ai-eval: target-store.ts (encrypt/decrypt + per-user CRUD)
issues.body:
## Summary
Implement `packages/ai-eval/src/target-store.ts` — server-only module that wraps Supabase service-role queries against `chatflow_targets`, encrypting the api_token via pgsodium on insert/update and decrypting only at outbound-call time.

Exports:
- `listTargets(userId): Promise<ChatflowTargetOutput[]>` — explicit projection, omits `api_token_encrypted` / `api_token_key_id`
- `getTarget(userId, id): Promise<ChatflowTargetOutput | null>` — same projection
- `createTarget(userId, input): Promise<ChatflowTargetOutput>` — encrypts api_token via `pgsodium.crypto_aead_det_encrypt(plaintext, additional_data, key_id)`, stores encrypted bytes + `PGSODIUM_KEY_ID`
- `updateTarget(userId, id, input): Promise<ChatflowTargetOutput>` — re-encrypts only when `api_token` is present in input; if absent, leaves existing encrypted column intact
- `deleteTarget(userId, id): Promise<void>`
- `decryptTokenForOutboundCall(userId, id): Promise<string>` — used **only** by the run processor; decrypts via `pgsodium.crypto_aead_det_decrypt`; the returned string MUST flow straight into `callChatflow`'s Authorization header and never be logged or returned to a client component

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] All queries are scoped on `user_id = auth.uid()` (or service-role + explicit user_id check)
- [ ] No public-facing function returns the encrypted column or the decrypted token
- [ ] `import "server-only"` at the top of the file — accidental client import trips the build
- [ ] No `console.log` / no `logger.info` / no `logger.error` of the api_token (verified by a grep test in CI: assertion that the file contains no logging of `apiToken` / `api_token` / `Authorization`)
- [ ] Unit/integration tests:
  - [ ] Encrypt → decrypt round-trip
  - [ ] Cross-user fetch returns null (RLS)
  - [ ] Update without `api_token` does not change the encrypted column (compare bytes before/after)
  - [ ] Update with `api_token` rotates the encrypted column and decrypts back to the new value
  - [ ] Listing a target never includes `api_token_encrypted` in the returned shape (object key not present)

issues.title: @repo/ai-eval: run-store.ts (run + run-row CRUD)
issues.body:
## Summary
Implement `packages/ai-eval/src/run-store.ts` — server-only Supabase wrapper for `chatflow_runs` and `chatflow_run_rows`.

Exports (signatures sketched):
- `createRun(userId, init): Promise<ChatflowRun>` — single transaction that inserts the run + materializes one row per input with stable `uid` and `position`; sets `total_rows`
- `getRunWithRows(userId, runId, opts?): Promise<{ run, rows }>` — paginated rows by `position`
- `listRuns(userId, opts?): Promise<{ runs, total }>` — filterable by mode/target, ordered by `"startedAt" desc`
- `updateRowResult(runId, rowId, patch): Promise<void>` — used by the processor as each row finishes
- `setRunStatus(runId, status, patch?): Promise<void>` — sets `running` / `completed` / `cancelled` / `errored` and bumps counters
- `markRunCancelled(userId, runId): Promise<void>` — set status=cancelled if the run belongs to the user and is queued/running
- `incrementRunCounters(runId, completed?, errored?): Promise<void>` — atomic increments

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] `createRun` is transactional (run + rows succeed or fail together)
- [ ] Counter updates are atomic (use rpc or `update ... set completed_rows = completed_rows + 1`)
- [ ] `markRunCancelled` is a no-op for already-terminal runs (completed/cancelled/errored)
- [ ] All read paths user-scoped via `user_id = $userId`
- [ ] Unit/integration tests cover the transactional create, cross-user read rejection, terminal-state guard on cancel, and the increment-counter atomicity

issues.title: @repo/ai-eval/ui: shared client components (theme-token clean)
issues.body:
## Summary
Land the five shared React client components in `packages/ai-eval/src/ui/`. All styles use `@repo/theme` tokens — no raw hex, no CSS variables from the source repo's stylesheet. The source repo's `--bg-primary`/`--text-primary`/`bg-red-500/10`/`text-accent-error` etc. all map to repo theme tokens; `pnpm audit:tokens` enforces.

Components:
- `<TargetEditor>` — modal/drawer form with name, apiHost, chatflowId, **write-only** apiToken (placeholder `•••••••` when editing existing; the existing value is never read into state), baseTraceUrl, defaultTag, promptTemplate (csv mode only). Validates URL, masks token field, surfaces "Leave blank to keep existing token" hint.
- `<TargetPicker>` — dropdown of user's targets + "+ New target" button.
- `<StatusBar>` — total / completed / errored / active counts + auto-save indicator.
- `<ProgressOverlay>` — modal with progress bar + cancel button.
- `<ResultsTable>` — virtualized; per-row status pill, response (JSON pretty-printed if applicable), Langfuse link, error message, single-row re-run button.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] All components use `@repo/theme` tokens; `pnpm audit:tokens` passes
- [ ] `<TargetEditor>` apiToken `<input>` has no `defaultValue` and no `value` derived from server data — it is always controlled-empty on open. A separate read-only "Token: ••• (leave blank to keep)" indicator may show that an existing token is set, but the existing value is never sent to the client.
- [ ] `<TargetEditor>` URL fields validated; submit disabled until valid
- [ ] `<ResultsTable>` is virtualized (e.g. react-window or equivalent already used in repo) and renders 1k rows without jank

issues.title: @repo/ai-eval: integration test for pgsodium round-trip and cross-user RLS
issues.body:
## Summary
Land `packages/ai-eval/src/__tests__/target-store.integration.test.ts` exercising the encryption boundary against a real local Supabase. This is the highest-stakes change in the milestone — secret storage. We want the integration test in place before any UI wires up.

Cases:
- Seed two users (A and B); A creates a target; service-role decrypt round-trips to plaintext
- Anon-role select on the table omits `api_token_encrypted` even from A's own row (we never expose it on the wire — projection + RLS combined)
- B cannot read A's target row (RLS)
- B cannot decrypt A's token even with a manually-issued service-role query that includes `user_id = A` filter (validates the function-level user_id check inside `decryptTokenForOutboundCall`)
- Rotation: re-encrypting under a new key id leaves prior rows decryptable under the old key (or fails loudly with a clear error — document which behavior we want)

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Test runs against a local Supabase started by the existing test harness
- [ ] All five cases above pass
- [ ] Cross-user decrypt rejection produces a clear error (no silent return of empty string)
- [ ] CI runs this test on every PR that touches `packages/ai-eval/`

issues.title: chatflow-eval: startEvalRun + processor with `after()` dispatch
issues.body:
## Summary
Implement the run-launch and processor server actions in `apps/web/app/apps/chatflow-eval/actions.ts` (or under a sibling `run.ts` re-exported from `actions.ts`). This is the load-bearing piece — it owns the queue execution lifecycle.

`startEvalRun(input)`:
- Tier-gated by `chatflow-eval:run` (pro) via `@repo/billing/has-feature-access`
- Validates input, clamps concurrency to tier cap (`enforceConcurrencyCap`)
- Cap run size to fit in a single 300 s Fluid Compute invocation: reject when `rows > min(rows, concurrency * 30)` with clear UI error "Split your set into smaller batches." (per the plan's MVP decision)
- Inside one transaction: creates the `chatflow_runs` row in `queued`, materializes one `chatflow_run_rows` per question with stable `uid` and `position`, snapshots `tag` from input or target, returns `runId`
- Dispatches the processor via `after()` from `next/server` so the action returns immediately

Processor (same file, kept private):
- Looks up `decryptTokenForOutboundCall` once at the start; in-memory only
- Sets run status to `running`
- Iterates rows via `runRollingQueue`; calls `callChatflow` per row; updates each row with response_text/response_json/langfuse_link/error
- Increments run counters atomically as rows finish
- Between rows: checks `chatflow_runs.status` — if `cancelled`, exits cleanly
- Maintains `Map<runId, AbortController>` in module scope for best-effort fetch abort on cancel
- On finish: sets status=completed (or errored if all rows errored)
- On uncaught throw: sets status=errored, persists message

`cancelRun(runId)`: sets status=cancelled (idempotent for terminal runs); aborts the in-memory controller if present.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] `startEvalRun` returns immediately with `runId` (does not block on processor completion)
- [ ] Tier gate enforced server-side; free user receives a `FeatureAccessDeniedError`
- [ ] Concurrency clamped to tier cap; UI input cannot raise above (validated server-side regardless)
- [ ] Run-size cap enforced with clear error message
- [ ] Processor wrapped in `withSpan('chatflow-eval.startEvalRun')` for OTel tracing

issues.title: chatflow-eval: Realtime channel subscription + polling fallback
issues.body:
## Summary
Wire the live-progress UI to the Supabase Realtime channel `chatflow:run:<runId>` published by the processor. Build an explicit polling fallback (per the plan risk note: realtime delivery is not guaranteed).

Client (`run-controls.tsx` or a dedicated hook):
- After `startEvalRun` returns `runId`, subscribe via `@supabase/ssr` browser client
- Merge inbound row updates into local state
- While a run is active and visible on the tab, poll `getRunWithRows(runId)` every 5 s as a fallback (skipped while tab is hidden, resumed on visibilitychange)
- On reload: rebuild state from `getRunWithRows` then resubscribe to the channel
- On run finish (status terminal): unsubscribe and stop polling

Server (processor in issue 19): publish `{ type: 'row', position, status, response_text?, response_json?, langfuse_link?, error? }` after each row finishes; publish `{ type: 'run', status }` on terminal transition.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Channel name exactly `chatflow:run:<runId>`
- [ ] Polling fallback fires every 5 s while run is non-terminal and tab is visible
- [ ] Reload mid-run rebuilds state correctly (rows already done show their results; queued rows still queued)
- [ ] Unsubscribe on run terminal (no leaked subscriptions)
- [ ] Polling pause on `visibilitychange` to hidden, resume on visible (saves quota)
- [ ] Component test (or playwright) covers reload-mid-run reconciliation

issues.title: csv-chatflow: server actions (uploadCSVForChatflow + run lifecycle)
issues.body:
## Summary
Implement the csv-chatflow server actions in `apps/web/app/apps/csv-chatflow/actions.ts`.

- `uploadCSVForChatflow(file)` — free tier; streams upload to `chatflow-uploads/<user_id>/<uuid>.csv` via service-role storage client; parses the first row as headers + first 5 rows as preview using `@repo/ai-eval/csv`; returns `{ storagePath, headers, sampleRows }`. Validates ≤25 MB and `text/csv` mime.
- `startCSVRun(input)` — pro tier (`csv-chatflow:run`); reads the uploaded CSV from storage, snapshots `target.prompt_template` into the run, materializes one `chatflow_run_rows` per CSV row (`input = { row: {...} }`), schedules processor (same dispatch pattern as issue 19, using `after()`).
- Processor: per row, interpolates `{{rowJson}}` into the snapshot prompt_template (length-bounded), calls `callChatflow` with that as `question`. Persists response_text and response_json (parsed if response is JSON, else null). Updates row + run counters.
- `cancelRun` (re-export of the package action / shared with chatflow-eval)
- `listRuns` / `getRunWithRows` (re-exports)
- `exportRunCSV` — uses `@repo/ai-eval/csv.formatCSVRunOutputCSV` (original headers + appended `ResponseJSON` column), uploads to `chatflow-results/`, returns signed URL

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Upload validates mime + size at the boundary
- [ ] Upload writes to user's own folder; cross-user upload via crafted path rejected by storage RLS (verify with a regression test)
- [ ] `startCSVRun` snapshots `prompt_template` from the target at run time (changes to the target after run start do not affect the run)
- [ ] Run-size cap enforced same as eval app (`min(rows, concurrency * 30)`)
- [ ] Prompt-template interpolation length-bounded (≤16 KiB after substitution; reject otherwise)
- [ ] Decrypted token never logged (same redaction as chatflow-eval)
- [ ] `withSpan('csv-chatflow.startCSVRun')` and `withSpan('csv-chatflow.exportRunCSV')`
- [ ] Unit tests cover boundary validation, prompt interpolation, snapshot semantics, tier gate
